name: Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a valid job offer from a local employer, who must certify the position through the Labour Department before Immigration will endorse the passport.
Employer must show it was unable to find a suitably qualified local candidate, typically by advertising the role locally first.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of local recruitment effort by employer

sources.title: Immigration Department, Antigua and Barbuda -- Extensions FAQs: work permit holders remain 'bona fide visitors' with conditional permission to work only, requiring Labour Department certification then Immigration Department endorsement; dependants ordinarily cannot join without special approval
Immigration Department, Antigua and Barbuda -- Residency Permit FAQs: entrepreneurs/investors ground requires 2 years of work permits before a Resident Permit application

Rivermate -- Antigua and Barbuda work permit guide: local-recruitment-first employer obligation, permit duration, fees, processing times (used because the Immigration Department's own visa-services subpages could not be retrieved directly in this pass -- see notes)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Antigua and Barbuda's initial build. STATUS: DRAFT. Work rights are marked 'restricted' (tied to the specific certified employer/position, not portable) and family_can_join is false by default per the tier-1 Extensions FAQ's statement that dependants of work permit holders ordinarily cannot live with them absent special Chief Immigration Officer approval -- a stricter default than most work-permit routes in this dataset. The tier-1 sources confirm the Labour-Department-then-Immigration-Department two-step process and the visitor/resident/citizen status framework under the Immigration and Passport Act 2014, but the Immigration Department's own visa-services and general-services subpages (which likely carry the authoritative fee schedule and permit-duration figures) returned a robots.txt fetch error in this pass -- duration (up to 2 years), fees, the local-recruitment-first requirement, and the police-clearance requirement are therefore sourced to a tier-3 relocation/EOR guide rather than gov.ag directly, which is why this route is held at draft status despite the process framework itself being tier-1 confirmed. Re-verify against the Labour Code or immigration.gov.ag's visa-services pages directly when accessible, then promote to published. leads_to_pr at 24 months reflects the Residency Permit FAQ's 'entrepreneurs/investors: 2 years of work permits' ground -- see ag_resident_permit_general.json.
